purpose: Bind independently seeded visible image fragments to frozen canonical Gaussian rows, then validate full center trajectories AND actual visible compositing footprints
model: Historical C1 final50000; read-only, no new Gaussian optimization
anchor_selection: Predeclared early/middle/late separated-component examples from prior audit, not random samples or independently heldout data
image_fragment_reference: Fresh local image labels per anchor. Raw bidirectional flow propagation only while >=30 supported pixels, >=0.95 purity and >=0.25 component area coverage; ambiguous/failed fragments terminate permanently in that anchor. No cross-occlusion identity reset or nearest relabeling.
full_contribution_method: Derivative of masked complete RGB compositor with respect to per-Gaussian override color, checked against direct binary cohort renders and full alpha; never normalize first20 metadata
frozen_bank: Canonical row IDs and canonical coordinates selected once at third seed observation. No per-frame reselection or parameter fitting.
evaluation: All120 original training cameras/times, complete frozen cohort trajectories/footprints including prebirth observations. Only frames after third seed observation count as forward validation; no heldout image benchmark/PSNR claim.
unknown_policy: Invisible footprint, failed center/flow/purity, terminated image fragment, ambiguous component, inadequate seed support all stay unknown. Record canonical-row overlap across anchors only as model-supported hypothesis, never a physical-ID merge.
full_reconstruction_gate: Requires persistent visible support and independently verified identity across occlusion; this bank alone cannot establish physical identity from a symmetric unseen interaction
